story:
Hi, I'm Brandon. I deliver for DoorDash here in Ridgecrest, and I've worked my way up to Platinum Dasher. I'm raising money for a dependable, fuel-efficient used car so I can keep working and build my deliveries back up.

Right now I'm completing about 23 deliveries a week. A late-pickup contract violation on my account is slowing down my offers until I finish 26 more deliveries, and to climb past that I need a car I can count on every single day. With a reliable car I can accept the orders I'm offered and work toward 40+ deliveries a week, which is what it takes to cover insurance, gas, upkeep and my bills on my own.

I've also learned how to keep this from happening again: when a pickup runs late, the app sometimes lets me wait it out or pass the rest of the delivery without hurting my completion rate, and I'll use that option.

My dad is helping me plan this, and I've done the homework. I've compared dozens of listings between Ridgecrest, Lancaster and Bakersfield, checked each car's reliability and safety recalls, and I'm focusing on cars like a used Prius, Corolla, Civic or Fit. A mechanic will inspect the car before anyone pays a cent.

Where the money goes
- A reliable, fuel-efficient used car: about $4,900 after negotiating
- Sales tax (9.25%): $453
- DMV title transfer and registration: $300
- Mechanic's pre-purchase inspection: $150
- GoFundMe fees (2.9% + $0.30 per donation): about $212
- Toward insurance and a repair fund: $35

If we raise more than the car costs, the extra goes to insurance and a repair fund so the car keeps running. I'll post updates here when the car is bought and on the road.

Thank you for reading, for sharing, and for anything you're able to give.
title: Help Brandon Get a Reliable Car for Work
